name: Keiko Shiratori
bio: Keiko Shiratori is a korean-japanese, she is the mother of Shin Sug-ok, a Zainichi activist and author.

credits.title: Horoomon
credits.overview: One woman. One racist lie. One lawsuit that shook Japan. Korean Japanese entrepreneur Shin Sugok takes on major media in this electro-shock legal thriller about refusing to be silenced.
